name: In Favor of the Light

meta.wiki: In Favor of the Light (Dun Morogh)
chain: In Favor of the Light (Dun Morogh)

summary: A young priest leaves Coldridge Valley for further study in Kharanos during In Favor of the Light. Branstock Khalder sends novitiates through the mountain tunnel to Priest Trainer Maxan Anvol, where they take on greater responsibilities and can earn their first formal vestments.

sections.title: Leaving the Anvil
sections.body: Dwarven priests begin their studies in Coldridge Valley under instructors such as Branstock Khalder. When a novice shows dedication and understanding of Holy magic, Khalder sends them beyond the mountains to Kharanos. There, priests face the needs of Dun Morogh's people, including their daily struggles and defense.

sections.title: A Step Toward Kharanos
sections.body: You reach Kharanos by traveling through the Coldridge Pass tunnel into central Dun Morogh. Priest Trainer Maxan Anvol guides students beyond basic prayers. He teaches that service to the Holy Light calls for moral character, physical hardiness, and an unyielding will. Students who prove their resolve under his guidance may receive their first formal garments of office.

faq.q: Who sends you on this journey?
faq.answer: Branstock Khalder, the priest trainer at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, sends you to Kharanos after you show enough aptitude with the Holy Light for further study.
Maxan Anvol is the priest trainer in the mountain village of Kharanos. He guides developing priests and teaches them to join devotion with physical endurance and mental fortitude.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Maxan Anvol?
aliases: what follows in favor of the light
faq.answer: Maxan Anvol asks you to prove your worth by helping injured locals in Garments of the Light. Afterward, he awards you your first official priest robes.

faq.q: Why must priests leave Coldridge Valley so early?
faq.answer: Coldridge Valley teaches the basics of combat and spellcraft. In Kharanos, priests meet the immediate needs and dangers facing a wider community, and learn to serve their people there.

faq.q: Do human priests receive this same quest?
aliases: human in favor of the light
faq.answer: Human priests in Elwynn Forest undertake the same rite under the same name. Priestess Anetta in Northshire sends them to Priestess Josetta in Goldshire.

faq.q: How does the dwarven view of the Light differ here?
faq.answer: Dwarves value physical strength, will, and practical endurance alongside piety. Maxan Anvol teaches that serving the Light in freezing mountain peaks calls for strength of body as well as faith.

angles.text: As a priest, you reach a milestone when you leave basic training for active service and receive your first vestments.
As a dwarf, you join spiritual devotion with practical resilience as you leave Coldridge for Dun Morogh's freezing winds.
